name: Asahi (Nagano, Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Asahi village emblem in white: a stylised letter G with an angular bar.
history: Municipal flag of Asahi, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Asahi village emblem — a stylised letter G with an angular bar
